name: Gaffe Ring
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a diplomat’s ring. Instead of granting a bonus it imparts a -5 penalty to all Diplomacy checks made by the wearer.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse, followed by eagle’s splendor, upon it, rendering it non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items diplomat’s ring

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
